st: Masterclass In Sicilian Sweets
d: Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli.

st: Best of Salina's Land and Sea
d: Jamie returns to cooking the food he loves the most, getting right to heart of the Italian kitchen.

st: Fast Paced Roman Recipes
d: Jamie tracks down some fast, fresh and easy recipes, featuring tasty minty pea tortiglioni and gnocchi with roasted tomato sauce and rocket pesto.

st: Tuscan Farmhouse Classics
d: Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.

st: Making Pizza in Naples
d: Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water.

st: Hand-Crafted Pasta in Puglia
d: Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella.

st: Italian Alps Comfort Food
d: Jamie is high up in the Italian Alps cooking some great comfort food, including dumplings, mind-blowing macaroni cheese, and a classic red wine and sausage risotto.

st: Roasting Hilltop Lamb in Basilicata
d: Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master.

st: Masterclass In Sicilian Sweets
d: Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli.

st: Best of Salina's Land and Sea
d: Jamie returns to cooking the food he loves the most, getting right to heart of the Italian kitchen.

st: Jamie Makes the World's Best Christmas Lasagne
d: Jamie throws the most festive Christmas Party! The menu includes cheesy filo parcels, a make-ahead Christmas cauliflower lasagne, and jerk-rubbed hasselback root veg with chicken kebabs. He finishes with a fudgy sticky toffee coffee pudding.

st: Jamie's Show-Stopping Christmas Porchetta
d: Jamie welcomes his family to his outdoor shed for Christmas dinner! He swaps turkey for a show-stopping festive porchetta, served with crispy roast potatoes. The menu also includes a veggie Brussels sprouts pie and a mulled wine pear pavlova.

st: Autumn's Last Bites: Squash Tagliatelle and Blackberry Cobbler
d: Jamie wraps up autumn with cheesy squash tagliatelle, a mushroom curry with crispy ginger rice, and celeriac rémoulade. He forages for blackberries to make a cobbler, the perfect end to a crisp autumn day.

st: Jamie Makes the World's Best Christmas Lasagne
d: Jamie throws the most festive Christmas Party! The menu includes cheesy filo parcels, a make-ahead Christmas cauliflower lasagne, and jerk-rubbed hasselback root veg with chicken kebabs. He finishes with a fudgy sticky toffee coffee pudding.

st: Jamie's Show-Stopping Christmas Porchetta
d: Jamie welcomes his family to his outdoor shed for Christmas dinner! He swaps turkey for a show-stopping festive porchetta, served with crispy roast potatoes. The menu also includes a veggie Brussels sprouts pie and a mulled wine pear pavlova.

st: Autumn's Last Bites: Squash Tagliatelle and Blackberry Cobbler
d: Jamie wraps up autumn with cheesy squash tagliatelle, a mushroom curry with crispy ginger rice, and celeriac rémoulade. He forages for blackberries to make a cobbler, the perfect end to a crisp autumn day.

st: Autumn's Harvest: Roast Chicken and Tarte Tatin
d: Jamie cooks a roast chicken with eggplant, bakes feta with figs & prosciutto, and creates a runner bean stew with fish. He shares tips for storing berries and chiles, finishing with a stunning pear tarte tatin.

st: Jamie's ULTIMATE Autumn Garden FEAST!
d: Jamie kicks off autumn with Italian-inspired cheesy cabbage pasta and smoky sweetcorn burgers with feta. He shares tips for storing onions and saving tomato seeds, finishing with a beautiful tomato galette for a perfect fall meal.

st: Crispy Pork Noodles and Cheesy Chard Cannelloni
d: Jamie celebrates rhubarb in a lip-smacking sauce, heroes spinach in a silky goat's cheese risotto and marries vibrant basil with chard in a crowd-pleasing cheesy spring cannelloni.

st: Spring Onion Chicken Curry and Sausage Broccoli Pizza
d: Jamie elevates asparagus spears for a fishy feat, makes spring onions the star of the show in his spicy green chicken curry and gives purple sprouting broccoli an Italian-inspired makeover.

st: Stuffed Salmon Celebration and Almond Custard Tart
d: Jamie snazzes up some spuds with wild garlic pesto, creates a broad bean mezze, rustles up a beautiful spring salad and honours rhubarb in a luscious custard tart with almond brittle.

st: Summer-y Sweet Pea Risotto and Slow Roasted Pork
d: Jamie celebrates summer with roasted fennel pork & gratin, oozy pea risotto, and rainbow slaw chicken wraps. He shares edible hanging basket tips. The feast finishes with stunning mackerel on sun-dried tomato couscous with colorful beets.

st: Alpine Lamb Ribs from Siddoway Sheep Company
d: Jess joins the lamb-raising Siddoway family as they begin sorting the animals that are ready for processing. She then returns to the lodge, where she demonstrates how to prepare and grill lamb ribs.

st: Benton's Famous Tennessee Hams
d: Jess loves country hams and there's no better place to visit than Benton's--a family-run business that's been perfecting curing and aging techniques for over 50 years.

st: Cylon Rolling Acres Goat Birria Tacos
d: Jess pitches in at Cylon Rolling Acres as owner Leslie Svacina runs her direct-to-consumer goat meat business.

st: Nashville Hot Dove Sliders at Redstone Ranch
d: Jess and her husband Chris head to their favorite hunting grounds, Redstone Ranch, situated in the heart of the migratory dove flyway.

st: Oklahoma's Wild Hog Sausage Roll
d: Jess heads to Oklahoma, where she takes aim at one of the state's estimated 1.5 million feral hogs. Then, she makes a wild hog sausage roll with jalapeño and cheddar.

st: Fort Worth Barbacoa Feast
d: Jess and her good friends, Fort Worth pitmaster Joe Riscky and Chef Juan Rodriguez, prepare a traditional barbacoa feast.

st: South Texas Deer Capture
d: Jess visits the East Foundation in South Texas to participate in a fast-paced, yet careful and methodical deer capture.

st: Smoked Elk Sandwiches at Juniper Mountain Ranch
d: Jess and her friend Shaundi Campbell meet up with guides from Juniper Mountain Ranch in southeastern Idaho to cull an elk for her smoked elk sandwiches.

st: Whole Hog BBQ with Pitmaster Pat Martin
d: Jess teams up with legendary West Tennessee pitmaster and whole hog expert Pat Martin to cook a hog overnight and enjoy a special cut of beef from Australia.

st: Live Fire Venison Backstrap in Oklahoma
d: With the help of a local Oklahoma guide, Jess sets out to hunt an axis deer, then shares butchery techniques and prepares a delicious backstrap grilled over live fire.

st: Northstar Bison Smash Burger
d: Jess visits Northstar Bison to learn about the small family-run ranch's breeding and processing operation, then prepares her signature smash burger.

st: Texas Tomahawk from Wyatt Ranches
d: Jess heads to Wyatt Ranches in South Texas to check out the cattle ranching operation they've been running since 1965.

st: The King of Open-Fire Paella
d: Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

st: Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast
d: Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

st: Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza
d: Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

st: Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs
d: Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

st: Venison Satay & Classic Venison Wellington
d: Andrew cooks an all-venison feast, starting with charred Indonesian satay and a deeply savory peanut sauce, then tackles a classic Wellington with mushroom duxelles, prosciutto, puff pastry and Bordelaise.

st: Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice
d: Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

st: Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo
d: Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo.

st: Carne Adovada
d: Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.

st: Holy Mackerel!
d: Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.

st: A Whole Roasted Hog
d: For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.

st: Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce
d: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.

st: Braised Pigeon with Homemade Herb Gnocchi
d: Chef Andrew Zimmern cooks braised squab with olives and vinegar, a perfect meal for a fall evening.

st: Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions
d: Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.

st: Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade
d: Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.

st: Venison Satay & Classic Venison Wellington
d: Andrew cooks an all-venison feast, starting with charred Indonesian satay and a deeply savory peanut sauce, then tackles a classic Wellington with mushroom duxelles, prosciutto, puff pastry and Bordelaise.

st: Hawaiian Plate Lunch
d: Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.

st: The Essence of Grill Culture
d: Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

st: Back to Our Caveman Roots
d: Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

st: Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese
d: Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.

st: Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg
d: Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

st: Venison Satay & Classic Venison Wellington
d: Andrew cooks an all-venison feast, starting with charred Indonesian satay and a deeply savory peanut sauce, then tackles a classic Wellington with mushroom duxelles, prosciutto, puff pastry and Bordelaise.

st: Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce
d: Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

st: The Most Underrated Game Bird
d: Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

st: How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home
d: Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.

st: Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread
d: Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

st: Game Day Fried Squab
d: Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.

st: The Wild Boar Playbook
d: Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.

st: Tailgate Surf-and-Turf Po'Boy Sandwiches
d: Seafood takes center stage as Andrew fries shrimp, squid and small whole fish for Sicilian-style fritto misto, then layers crispy walleye and oysters into a fully dressed po'boy with savory beef gravy.

st: Game Day Chicago-Style Beef Sandwich
d: Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas.

st: The Ultimate Elk Tailgate
d: It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

st: Poultry Perfection: Moroccan Spiced Guinea Hen with Charred Vegetables
d: Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.

st: Bison Tomahawk Chop with Italian-style Eggplant and Panzanella
d: Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.

st: Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad
d: Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.

st: Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread
d: Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

st: Grilled Eggplant Caponata Toast and Crispy Squab Katsu
d: Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.

st: Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash
d: Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.

st: Hunting for Quail in Charleston
d: Pat and his pal Jason Stanhope meet up outside of Charleston for a day of quail hunting and grilling birds over live coals.

st: Spearfishing off Florida's Emerald Coast
d: Pat travels to the Emerald Coast of Destin, Florida, to join his friend Adam Evans on a spearfishing adventure, sourcing fresh fish to cook over live fire.

st: Searching for Oaxaca in Tennessee
d: Pat visits Edgar Victoria, known for bringing the street foods of Mexico City to Nashville, to do some live fire cooking out in nature as they prepare one of his favorite dishes - skirt steak tlayuda.

st: Santa Maria Style Sirloin Steak
d: Pat Martin travels to a picturesque cattle farm in California's Santa Maria Valley, to hear firsthand from a young pitmaster who has uncovered the secrets of real Santa Maria barbecue.

st: Discovering Indian Lamb Kebabs in Nashville
d: Pat grills riverside with renowned chef Vivek Surti, crafting lamb kofta and chicken kebabs inspired by his Indian heritage.

st: Uncovering Houston BBQ's Asian Influences
d: Pat meets the trio behind Blood Bros BBQ to discover how three childhood friends seamlessly blended their Asian-American culture with the Texas barbecue traditions they grew up with.

st: Barbecued Pork Steak
d: Pat Martin travels to Gainesboro, Tennessee to visit a free-range hog farm, learn about their operations, and grill up a less desired, but no less delicious, cut of hog - pork steaks.

st: The Secret to Texas-Style Smoked Brisket
d: Pat and his buddy Leonard Botello use the flavors of the beloved native Post Oak to smoke a perfect Central Texas-style beef brisket.

st: The Roscoe Family Legacy: Alabama Pit Ribs
d: Pat heads to Birmingham to team up with artist and chef Roscoe Hall, cooking ribs inspired by Roscoe's family legacy.

st: Hickory Smoked Virginia Ham & Mint Juleps
d: Pat Martin gets a history lesson on the origin of American barbecue from "The Professor" Tuffy Stone.

st: South Carolina's Coastal Fish Grill
d: Pat fishes the coastal inlets of Charleston, South Carolina, in search of a delicious sheepshead, which he plans to grill with his friend and chef James London.

st: Red Curry Braised Pork with Mustard Greens
d: Pat Martin is in the frozen tundra of Minnesota to visit his new friend, Chef Yia Vang. They brave the cold and break nearly-frozen ground to barbecue a pig's head in the earth.

st: West Tennessee Whole Hog
d: Pat Martin teams up with fellow pitmasters to showcase the rugged and nuanced tradition of whole-hog cooking, West Tennessee-style.

st: South Carolina Peach-Glazed Ribs with Rice Middlins
d: When Pat's friends and fellow barbecue chefs, Bryan Furman and Dr. Howard Conyers, come to town, the guys dig deep into the tricks and traditions of one of Bryan's specialties: pork ribs.

st: Bluefin Tuna Collars with Chili Pickle Relish
d: Pat Martin visits chef Adam Perry Lang in Los Angeles, where the pair cooks a prized catch castoff cut - Bluefin Tuna collars.

st: The Legend of Louis Mueller's Dino Beef Ribs
d: Pat visits his close friend Wayne Mueller, third-generation pitmaster of Louis Mueller's BBQ, to learn the ins and outs of his famous dino beef ribs.

st: Pit-Cooked Chicken with Alabama White Sauce
d: Pat Martin travels to Decatur, Alabama to visit a storied institution of barbecue - Big Bob Gibson's. There, he learns the ins, the outs, and the history of a regional delicacy: pit-cooked chicken with Alabama white sauce.

st: Live Fire Whole Trout
d: Pat Martin heads to the Cherokee National Forest for a day of fly-fishing with an old friend, and to cook up their fresh catch over the campfire.

st: Greek Spit Roast Lamb
d: Pat Martin links up with his pal, Bill Darsinos, to enjoy a tradition from the heart of Bill's Greek culture when they cook a whole lamb on a spit roast.

st: Catching Gulf Coast Redfish and Blue Crabs
d: Pat visits Houston to go Gulf Bay fishing with chef Chris Shepherd, hoping to catch some redfish and gather a side of blue crabs.

st: Every Kind of Rib: Dino, Fried, Smoked, Grilled and Glazed
d: It's Rib Day on BBQ Smokeout! Noah and Kev are cooking Dino Beef Ribs, Fried St. Louis Pork Ribs, Smoked Pork Spare Ribs with a Hennessey Glaze, and Smoke-Grilled Baby Backs. Plus we're making good old fashioned Dirty Cabbage.

st: These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair
d: Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.

st: The Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye
d: It's Steak Day! We're making a Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye; Steak & Eggs; Carne Asada Tacos with Refried Beans and Charred Tomato Salsa; and a Grilled Pork Chop with a Peach Glaze.

st: Beef Shank is the New Brisket
d: Kevin and Noah are smoking a humungous Thor's Hammer; cooking up some Catfish & Eggs for breakfast; making a Grilled Salsa Verde; and putting on a pot of Mezcal Charro Beans.

st: The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket
d: Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They're pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings.

st: Why LA's Danger Dog is the Best Thing You'll Ever Eat
d: Kevin & Noah make their twists on some L.A. outdoor classics: Backyard Burgers 2 Ways; Pit-Smoked Pollo Asado; Grilled Mexican Street Corn and Bacon-Wrapped Danger Dogs.

st: The Only Pulled Pork Recipe You'll Ever Need
d: Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo.

st: Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice
d: We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens.

st: Louisiana Style Crawfish Boil
d: It's Crawfish Boil Day on the show. Noah and Kev are making a gigantic Crawfish Boil; plus Smoked King Crab Legs; Grilled Rainbow Trout with Brown Butter and Grilled Lemon; and Kev's famous Red Beans and Rice.

d: It's Steak Day! We're making a Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye; Steak & Eggs; Carne Asada Tacos with Refried Beans and Charred Tomato Salsa; and a Grilled Pork Chop with a Peach Glaze.

st: Beef Shank is the New Brisket
d: Kevin and Noah are smoking a humungous Thor's Hammer; cooking up some Catfish & Eggs for breakfast; making a Grilled Salsa Verde; and putting on a pot of Mezcal Charro Beans.

st: The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket
d: Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They're pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings.

st: These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair
d: Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.

st: Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice
d: We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens.

st: The Only Pulled Pork Recipe You'll Ever Need
d: Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo.

st: Louisiana Style Crawfish Boil
d: It's Crawfish Boil Day on the show. Noah and Kev are making a gigantic Crawfish Boil; plus Smoked King Crab Legs; Grilled Rainbow Trout with Brown Butter and Grilled Lemon; and Kev's famous Red Beans and Rice.

st: Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew
d: Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.

st: Poultry Perfection: Moroccan Spiced Guinea Hen with Charred Vegetables
d: Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.

st: Holy Mackerel!
d: Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.

st: Wild Seafood Risotto
d: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.

st: Crispy Duck Noodle Soup
d: Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.

st: Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha
d: Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.

st: The Ultimate Elk Tailgate
d: It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

st: Venison Satay & Classic Venison Wellington
d: Andrew cooks an all-venison feast, starting with charred Indonesian satay and a deeply savory peanut sauce, then tackles a classic Wellington with mushroom duxelles, prosciutto, puff pastry and Bordelaise.

st: Feast of the Seven Fishes
d: A lifelong outdoorsman and chef, Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking wild food over an open fire, creating delicious and easy meals, while sharing tips for sourcing, butchering and preparing game meat and fish.

st: Duck Smash Tacos & Danish Christmas Duck
d: From a crispy-edged duck smash tacos piled with pickled greens to a traditional Danish Christmas roast with sweet-and-sour cabbage, potatoes and rich pan gravy, Andrew shows just how versatile duck can be.

st: Jollof Rice & Christmas-Style Crab Tamales
d: Andrew makes two festive seafood dishes built for holiday entertaining, smoky West African jollof rice topped with grilled shrimp and scallops, and tender crab tamales served Christmas-style with complementary red and green salsas.

st: Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg
d: Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

st: The King of Open-Fire Paella
d: Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

st: Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread
d: Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.
